messages:
sophia: Compliance just flagged archived snapshots with retention >5y. They want explicit escrow records and an auditable restore flow. I found a bunch of archives with only an ARN in metadata, no key version/fingerprint.

jordan: can you paste a sample manifest?

sophia: sample from bucket: 
object: tenant-128/snapshots/2022-03-11-archive.tar.gz
s3-tags: retention=7y, encrypted_by=cmk-archive-v1
metadata: {"backup_agent": "uploader-3.1", "kms_key": "arn:aws:kms:us-east-1:111:key/cm-archive-v1", "created_by": "backup-service"}

liam: we never persisted key-version or fingerprint, only ARN. If CMK was rekeyed or rewrapped, restores could fail.

maya: also, object-lifecycle tag events aren't forwarded into our main audit index. Those events live in a separate bucket today.

encops-bot: ALERT: backup-agent v2.9.0 deployed to prod (canary=us-east-1).

sophia: Proposed remediations: 1) persist CMK key-version + key-fingerprint and DEK envelope id in snapshot manifest at write-time; 2) implement per-tenant DEKs encrypted under CMK and push encrypted-DEK to compliance escrow store; 3) forward object-lifecycle/tag events to audit-index; 4) switch restores to ephemeral KMS grants (24h) instead of long-lived roles.

jordan: +1. For archives older than 1y require an approval step: requester identity, approver, retention rationale, and the grant-id recorded.

liam: quick POC for ephemeral grant create: 
aws kms create-grant --key-id arn:aws:kms:us-east-1:111:key/cm-archive-v1 --grantee-principal arn:aws:iam::222:role/restore-runner --operations Decrypt --constraints EncryptionContextEquals={"tenant":"tenant-128"} --retire-on 2025-01-01T00:00:00Z
Store grant-id in audit log and retire after restore.

amanda (legal): audit chain must include who requested, who approved, when, and the grant id. Also need retention rationale for GDPR requests.

ops-restores: note: current pipeline assumes iam:PassRole to a permanent role. Switching to grants will require fetching the grant and attaching it to the decrypt step. I can scope a patch to restore-runner in ~2 days.

sophia: action items:
- liam: add key-fingerprint + encrypted-DEK escrow to manifest and migration check for archive buckets (ETA 3d)
- maya: forward object-lifecycle events to audit-index and add tests (ETA 4d)
- ops-restores: implement ephemeral grant flow + record grant-id + requester identity in audit (ETA 2d)
- amanda: draft legal approval template and retention rationale form (ETA EOD)

jordan: quick mitigations: fail restores if manifest missing key-fingerprint, and run a daily canary that attempts decrypt+checksum against a sample of archived snapshots.

encops-bot: SCHEDULED: canary-restore-job nightly 02:00 UTC created by ops-restores.

liam: vuln triage note: backup-agent used to emit a debug header containing partial upload paths. Filed ISSUE-4571. Short-term: rotate uploader tokens and scrub headers on reupload.

sophia: add that to remediation list.

maya: I'll prioritize audit forwarding so we can prove past restore chains.

sophia: I'll write a short RFC for manifest schema change + migration plan and post it. Ping me for a 15m sync. :thumbsup:
